title: Rules-text words
description: The rules text as this language prints it, one entry per ability of the card, paired by ability_id with the card's structure. An ability's text is the sequence of pieces the printed ability consists of. Every piece is an object with a kind: a piece of kind rawText holds the words, and a piece of any other kind is a reference that names the component's kind and ID, so the component holds itself once in its list.

ability_id.description: The ability_id of the ability this text belongs to in the card.

text.description: The sequence of pieces that ability's printed words consist of. A piece of kind rawText holds the words between the others: {"kind": "rawText", "value": " deals 3 damage to any target."}. A piece of kind mana_symbol is the mana symbol that ID names (CR 107.4): the database holds only the ID, and the application assembles the printed notation from it. A piece of kind keyword_ability is the keyword ability that ID names: the application prints the word that this language's keyword_ability list holds for the ID. For an activated ability, the words after the cost's colon (CR 602.1a): the card holds the cost as structure, and the application assembles the printed symbol (the loyalty symbol per CR 107.7) and the colon.

value.description: The words of that piece, as this language prints them.

id.description: The ID of a mana symbol (CR 107.4); the application assembles the printed notation from it. A generic mana symbol (CR 107.4b) is named by the numeral it prints, and no list holds it.
The ID of a keyword ability; the word for the ID comes from this language's keyword_ability list.
